title: Agno PandasTools permits code execution through model-controlled function selection
summary: PandasTools forwards model-controlled function names to getattr. Prompt injection can select pandas.read_pickle on an attacker path for code execution, or other readers for local file access.

severity.rationale: Code execution requires PandasTools and attacker influence over agent tool calls. Untrusted content influencing a tool-using agent is a common exposure.

affected.note: CVE record lists affected versions through 3.1.11; it specifies no fixed release.

exposure: Exposed agents load PandasTools and allow model-selected pandas functions to process attacker-controlled paths.

params.instructions: Check whether agno is 3.1.11 or earlier and whether PandasTools exposes model-selected pandas functions.

remediation.action: Contain exposure and apply a verified fix
remediation.details: As a containment recommendation, disconnect PandasTools from untrusted workflows until a vendor-verified fix is deployed. Do not infer that the next numbered version fixes it.
remediation.risk: Medium. Disabling the affected capability interrupts dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the version or revision and review the affected configuration before restoring untrusted input.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
